text.p: Grain and oilseed exports reported by USDA and private export sources.

WHEAT SALE - The Egyptian state's Food Industries Company bought 110,000 tonnes of U.S. or Australian wheat on Thursday at about $167 a tonne, a trader said. The wheat is for shipment between June 1 and 10. The company bought 55,000 tonnes from Finagrain and 55,000 tonnes from Tradigrain. The origin is supplier's option but the trader said it would certainly be U.S. He said the price was either $166.85 or $166.65 a tonne C and F.
WHEAT SALE - The CCC said Thursday it had bought 2,170 tonnes of U.S. hard red winter wheat from ADM Co for export to Uganda, March 1-25 shipment. The wheat was priced at $178.87 a tonne, FOB Ama.
WHEAT AND BARLEY SALE - The Japanese Food Agency said Thursday it bought 80,000 tonnes of U.S. wheat, 20,000 of Canadian barley and 20,000 of Australian barley at its weekly tender.
BARLEY SALE - Libya purchased 300,000 tonnes of feed barley during past weeks, traders in Tripoli confirmed on Thursday. Dates were not specified for shipment nor price.

CORN SALE - The CCC bought 27,170 tonnes of U.S. yellow corn from Cargill Inc for export to Uganda, Mozambique and Angola, March 1-25 shipment. The total comprised 10,000 tonnes to Uganda, 9,260 tonnes to Mozambique and 7,910 tonnes to Angola. The corn was priced at $122.26, FOB Reserve.

SORGHUM SALE - The CCC bought 15,000 tonnes of U.S. sorghum for export to Uganda and Ethiopia, March 1-25 shipment. The total comprised 10,000 tonnes from Farmland Industries for Ethiopia at a cost of $111.08 per tonne, FOB Galveston and 5,000 tonnes from ADM/Growmark for Uganda at a cost of $113.26 per tonne, FOB Ama.

WHEAT TENDERS - Philippine flour millers are seeking suppliers to buy 40,000 tonnes of U.S. wheat for February 27 to March 24 delivery, traders involved in the deal said. The traders say the firms want to buy around 16,400 tonnes of western white wheat, 11,700 tonnes of dark northern spring wheat with a protein content of 13.5 percent, and 11,900 tonnes of dark northern spring wheat.

- Pakistan will hold side-by-side tenders for 360,000 tonnes of U.S. soft white wheat and Australian white milling wheat. Bids for both tenders will be opened on February 16 and must be valid on February 17. Shipment was for March 5-31.

WHEAT TENDERS - Iraq will seek 50,000 tonnes U.S. wheat on February 11 under the U.N. Food-for-Oil deal, several U.S. exporters said. The tender would be divided into two lots of 25,000 tonnes each, one for April delivery and the other for May.

- Syria's General Establishment for Cereal Processing and Trade has offered 40,000 tonnes of hard durum amber wheat for sale. An international call setting February 12 as the final date for bids had already been issued. Confirmation would be made on February 13.

WHEAT TENDER - Sri Lanka has opened a tender for 100,000 tonnes of optional origin wheat, for delivery in two lots of hard and soft wheat, the Cooperative Wholesale Establishment said. The tender, for 50,000 tonnes each of hard and soft wheat, will close on February 7.

SOYBEAN OIL - The CCC said it would tender February 11 for 11,670 tonnes of U.S. bulk crude degummed soybean oil under its export program to Peru. The delivery period was for March 20 to April 5. The tender was for reply on February 12.
RICE TENDERS - Colombia is preparing to tender for up to 50,000 tonnes of rice to help cover a shortfall in domestic production, Agriculture Ministry sources said.

- Syria's General Foreign Trade Organisation for Chemicals and Foostuffs has issued an international tender to buy 12,000 tonnes of white rice for shipment in April. March 3 was set as the final date to receive bids and confirmation would be made on March 12.

MARKET TALK - The U.N. cleared this week the sale of 100,000 tonnes of French soft wheat to Iraq under a scheme allowing Baghdad to sell oil in exchange for food and medicine, a French official said on Thursday.
... The USDA said Jamaica signed a PL480 agreement to buy $10 million worth of U.S. rice in fiscal year 1997.
